instruction: How to register for online banking?
output: Register for NetBanking: 1) Visit bank website, 2) Click 'Register for NetBanking', 3) Enter account number and registered mobile, 4) Enter OTP received on mobile, 5) Create user ID and password, 6) Set security questions. Login credentials sent via SMS. Activate within 30 days.
